incomplete_not_pass:
incomplete_not_pass (run : Run) (valid : Bool) (p95Micros : Nat) (h : ¬complete run) :
  classify run valid p95Micros = Classification.incomplete
pass_iff:
pass_iff (run : Run) (valid : Bool) (p95Micros : Nat) :
  classify run valid p95Micros = Classification.pass ↔ complete run ∧ valid = true ∧ p95Micros < 50000
